scope: existing category/budget/reminder/privacy product save controller; no authority/service/SDK rewrite
implemented: Empty/malformed successful HTTP responses cannot clear drafts, delete uncertain intents, attest activity or produce saved notifications.

Category normalized name/color/id/source/time; budget category/amount/period/start; reminder optional amount/schedule/date/enabled/sourceRef; privacy exact three booleans and persisted timestamp bind receipts to submitted content.
Unsafe integer/fractional planning quantities and invalid payloads do not send requests.
Same-draft explicit retry preserves existing idempotency key and original computed time/body. Current account/context fencing and draft edit protection remain unchanged.

tests.boundary: Actual local Chromium with controlled API responses and isolated existing Go HTTP persistence test. Not official public runtime, real Wallet approval or authenticated production business evidence.
